_comment: The evolution tree, loaded when the game starts. Tower stats are in towers.json.
lines: each line starts with a tower bought from the panel (in this order, hotkeys 1, 2, 3...).
Two identical tier 1 towers fuse into the tier 2 tower; two identical tier 2 towers fuse into
one of the two tier 3 towers, and the player picks which.
finals: a cross-type tier 4 tower and the two tier 3 towers, from different lines, that fuse into it.
